skill.name: session-template
skill.description: Apply task-specific planning templates for feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, and security work using ai-update-plan.
skill.summary: Adds structured, task-specific planning checklists to AI coding sessions.

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown backticks, shell examples, and checklist wording as potential command execution or reconnaissance. Manual review found these are documentation and planning examples for local workflow tooling, with no prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent observed.

content.value_statement: Coding sessions often miss planning steps, tests, or review gates. This skill applies focused templates that turn tasks into clear AI work plans.
actual_capabilities: Selects a planning template for feature, bugfix, refactor, documentation, or security tasks.
Provides phase-based checklists for research, tests, implementation, quality checks, and documentation.
Shows how to load template files and add plan items with ai-update-plan.
Guides customization of generic checklist items for a specific coding task.
Supports combined or extended templates for complex development work.
limitations: It does not implement code changes or fixes by itself.
It assumes ai-update-plan and expected project documentation are available.
Keyword-based template selection may need user correction for ambiguous tasks.
Shell examples depend on local project tooling and repository layout.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Feature
use_cases.description: Create a feature plan with research, TDD, implementation, quality checks, documentation, and final review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflow
use_cases.description: Give developers consistent phase checklists for common coding tasks before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Structure Security Fixes
use_cases.description: Apply a security-focused plan covering impact analysis, exploit tests, hardening, review, and documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Basic Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a clear task type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the feature template for adding profile settings. Customize each phase for this repository and keep the plan concise.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Right Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning when the task type is unclear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest the best session template for fixing an intermittent test failure. Explain the choice, then create a focused plan.

prompt_templates.title: Customize Existing Plan Items
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the refactor template to the payment module. Replace generic checklist items with concrete steps from the current codebase.

prompt_templates.title: Combine Multiple Templates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for complex or high-risk work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine security and refactor planning for hardening authentication middleware. Keep risk assessment, tests, rollout, and documentation separate.

output_examples.input: Plan a bug fix for a crash in the data processor.
output: Plan includes reproduction, root cause analysis, regression tests, minimal fix, quality checks, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Create a plan for adding OAuth2 authentication.
output: Feature template selected with security review included.
Plan covers integration research, TDD coverage, implementation, validation, documentation, and final review.

output_examples.input: Refactor the reporting module without changing behavior.
output: Plan starts with baseline tests, then moves through small refactor steps, verification, and documentation updates.

best_practices: Apply the template before implementation so missing steps are visible early.
Customize generic checklist items with concrete module names, tests, and quality gates.
Remove irrelevant steps and add task-specific risks as the work becomes clearer.
anti_patterns: Do not keep a full template unchanged when parts do not apply.
Do not treat the generated plan as a replacement for reading project documentation.
Do not skip verification steps after customizing or combining templates.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It applies structured planning templates to AI coding sessions for common task types.

faq.question: Which task types are supported?
faq.answer: It supports feature development, bug fixes, refactoring, documentation work, and security fixes.

faq.question: Does it write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates and customizes a work plan before code changes happen.

faq.question: Does it require ai-update-plan?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow examples assume ai-update-plan is available in the project environment.

faq.question: Can templates be customized?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill encourages replacing generic checklist items with task-specific steps.

faq.question: Is it useful for security work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a security template with assessment, tests, hardening, review, and documentation phases.
